title: David L. Baker Golf Course
gap: Price for green fees not stated
blurb: David L. Baker Golf Club features an 18-hole, par-62 executive golf course with gently rolling terrain, six lakes, undulating greens, and bunkers. It offers a fun and accessible round for beginners, casual players, and experienced golfers. The club also provides a banquet center for weddings, receptions, corporate functions, and special celebrations with customizable event support and on-site catering.
